claim_scores.rationale: Uses bare `gpt-4o-mini`, patches both LiteLLM capability checks, and asserts each saw `custom_llm_provider='openai'`.
Patches `litellm.completion`, runs under `dspy.JSONAdapter()`, and asserts the parsed JSON result gives `prediction.answer == 'ok'`.
Prints and asserts `type(lm.provider).__name__ == 'Provider'`, showing generic provider inference rather than `OpenAIProvider`.
Calls `lm.finetune(...)`, captures the `ValueError`, and asserts the message contains `does not support fine-tuning`.
